name: sk-tool-call-card
title: Tool Call Card
description: Names the action an agent is taking while it takes it, with an indeterminate bar that proves the app is alive without pretending to measure progress. Running, success and failure states; arguments and results stay collapsed behind a disclosure.
author: Ahmed Gagan
usage:
SKToolCallCard("search_web", summary: "Q3 revenue", state: .running)
SKToolCallCard("read_file", state: .success, detail: json, duration: 0.42)
